# v1.0.0 — Post-pilot release

First public release of the DCDC Network course **Introduction to R for SPSS Users**, following the two-day pilot delivered at the University of Aruba on 22 and 24 April 2026.

## What this release contains

- Seven episodes covering the SPSS-to-R transition: workspace setup, data import, tidyverse manipulation, ggplot2 visualization, statistical analysis, R Markdown reporting, and an open-lab episode with text analysis.
- A flagship capstone template (`episodes/files/xander-bogaerts-report-template.Rmd`) demonstrating reproducible reporting from live MLB Stats API pulls, used as the Friday afternoon target.
- Workshop datasets in CSV and XLSX form, including Aruba visitor arrivals and the UA `island-research-reference-data` SIDS pull.
- Standalone learner homework page bridging Day 1 and Day 2.
- Six instructor FAQ cards, including ISIC/ISCO classification handling for civil-servant audiences.
- Carpentries Workbench scaffolding with rendered site at https://university-of-aruba.github.io/r-for-spss-users/.

## Pilot delivery

Cohort 1 ran 22 and 24 April 2026 at the University of Aruba. Day 2 revisions in this release reflect cohort feedback. Materials are CC-BY 4.0 and designed for replication on other Dutch Caribbean islands.

## Citation

Once Zenodo mints the DOI for this release, the citation block on the lesson site and `CITATION.cff` should be updated to reference it.
